ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface area with low-intensity (black) borders; approximate 85:15 white-to-black pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central lobes. Black pigmentation is mapped to the trailing edge periphery and a significant vertical cluster centered at the median notch. Sparse black mottling is scattered across the interior ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with an approximate vertex angle of 105 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations with pixel-amplitudes between 4-10 pixels; serrations are jagged and irregular, appearing most prominently on the upper-right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward sweep on the distal portion of the lobes, curving into an acute angle at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, textured clusters of off-white/yellowish geometric masses (barnacles) located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral fields; notable horizontal streak on the mid-left lobe and multiple vertical/diagonal streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the terminal tips and prominent dark linear rake marks (tooth scars) across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The black pigmentation at the median notch forms a distinctive 'Y' shape that extends vertically toward the peduncle junction.
